description: Defines a generic abstract class 'Collection' with related interfaces for managing collections of items, including methods for querying, setting, and discarding elements, as well as handling references and conflicts.

classes.name: Collection
classes.description: An abstract class managing a collection of items with support for different states (decrypted, encrypted, deleted), including indexing, reference management, and conflict resolution.

methods.name: uuids
methods.description: Returns all UUIDs in the collection.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all elements, optionally filtered by content type.

methods.name: nondeletedElements
methods.description: Returns all elements not marked as deleted.

methods.name: invalidElements
methods.description: Returns all elements that are error decrypting or waiting for a key.

methods.name: dirtyElements
methods.description: Returns all elements marked as dirty.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Finds all elements matching given UUIDs.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if an element exists by UUID.

methods.name: findAllIncludingBlanks
methods.description: Finds all elements by UUIDs, including undefined if not found.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets one or multiple elements into the collection, updating indexes and references.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Removes elements from the collection and updates indexes.

methods.name: uuidReferencesForUuid
methods.description: Gets direct relationship UUIDs for a given UUID.

methods.name: uuidsThatReferenceUuid
methods.description: Gets inverse relationship UUIDs for a given UUID.

methods.name: referencesForElement
methods.description: Gets elements referenced by a given decrypted element.

methods.name: conflictsOf
methods.description: Gets conflict elements for a given UUID.

methods.name: elementsReferencingElement
methods.description: Gets elements referencing a given decrypted element, optionally filtered by content type.

methods.name: setToTypedMap
methods.description: Adds an element to the typed map index.

methods.name: deleteFromTypedMap
methods.description: Removes an element from the typed map index.
